what: Structural completeness checks for CairnCommons/tickets/ — the ticket-side counterpart of build_inspector.
why: MEASURED 2026-08-26: 305 findings across 79 of 86 not-done tickets, 16 defect classes. The build loop stalls re-discovering what is missing from each ticket. The sorted door checks at cast time; nothing checks at rest. This tool checks at rest.
how_it_learns: A new defect class adds a check to the roster, same as build_inspector gains a sieve when a new failure class is found. The roster is the enumeration; a check outside it is invisible.
owns: The check roster, the finding shape, the CLI entry point (cairn tickets). Does NOT own the tickets themselves — it reads them.
proof_contract: Each check fires on a fixture exhibiting its defect and stays quiet on a clean ticket. The roster coverage test asserts every check in the roster fires on at least one fixture.
complexity_rung: tool — stateless predicates over ticket JSON, no owned state. Tools have users, not owners (Law 6).
